actions.description: Start the pump with the native start command 1H; the upstream reads no reply to it
actions.name: start_pump

outputs.description: True once the upstream callback reported that its worker wrote 1H to the serial port; not a pump acknowledgement
outputs.name: written

actions.description: Send the native stop command 1I (an ordinary command, not a confirmed safe state); the upstream reads no reply to it
actions.name: stop_pump

outputs.description: True once the upstream callback reported that its worker wrote 1I to the serial port; not a pump acknowledgement
outputs.name: written

adjusts.description: Pump speed set point; the native command carries int(value), zero-padded to at least five digits
adjusts.name: setpoint

facts.text: Ismatec is an Ismatec pump controller
_process_request writes '1H' for the start request and '1I' for the stop request, each followed by chr(13)

For set_flowrate _process_request writes '1S' followed by str(int(flowrate)).zfill(5); for get_flowrate it writes '1S', sleeps 0.3 and converts the reply line, split at '\r' and stripped of '*', with float()
The set_flowrate and get_flowrate docstrings name the value pump rpm (1/min)
_process_request calls the callback with its response and then sleeps 0.3; the response stays True for start, stop and set_flowrate, for which no reply is read
start, stop, set_flowrate and get_flowrate only queue a request that carries the caller's callback
The class body defines no run-state query; its only read of the serial line is the readline of the get_flowrate request
Instrument.__init__ stores the port and creates the request queue, a queue.Queue
_process_queue takes one request at a time from the queue and calls _process_request with it in a while True loop that has no exception handler
_queue_request puts the request on the queue and returns
_start_threads starts one daemon thread that runs _process_queue
connect() creates Serial(port=self._port, baudrate=9600, bytesize=8, parity='N', stopbits=1, timeout=0.5)
connect() then writes '@1' and '1M', each followed by chr(13)
ismatec.py imports Serial from serial and Instrument from instruments.instrument
The project image installs pyserial, PyYAML, coloredlogs, numpy, scipy and opcua with pip
The project image's entry point runs python -m project.ismatec_deltav

project/ismatec_deltav.py constructs Ismatec('/dev/ttyUSB0') and calls main() at import; run_command calls start() when START_CONTROLLER is true and stop() when it is false, and main() sets run_command as the OPC subscriber's callback
docker-compose.yml builds the project image from src/project/Dockerfile and runs it with /dev/ttyUSB0 mapped in and restart unless-stopped

measures.description: Pump speed reported by get_flowrate; the upstream docstring names it pump rpm, and the clone does not say whether the pump answers with the set or the measured speed
measures.name: rate

operator_required.name: setpoint
operator_required.reason: no line of the clone states a pump speed range; the operator supplies the range of this unit

safe_state.description: none confirmed: the e-stop queues the native stop 1I and reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED; the upstream reads no reply to 1I and has no run-state query, the stop waits behind requests queued before it, and once a request raises, the single worker thread ends and nothing queued is written, so the pump may still run
